fusions.name: Devour the Marked
fusions.desc: Sends the swarm at the first enemy it meets for 16 damage, uses up every affliction you have on it, and deals 50% more damage for each one.

fusions.name: Compound Stare
fusions.desc: Looks down a wide cone 4 tiles ahead of you, dealing 3 damage to everything in it, with a 50% chance per hit to leave them [Marked] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Held for the Swarm
fusions.desc: Holds every creature within 4 tiles in place for 3 seconds. For 6 seconds, an escort of locusts fights beside you, striking for 5 damage every 1.4 seconds.

fusions.name: Singled Out
fusions.desc: You deal 10% more damage to enemies carrying your afflictions. You also have 5% more dodge chance.
